name: Lossless-INR
definition: A lossless INR framework for 3D scientific volumetric data that achieves zero bit-error rate and bit-exact reconstruction by decomposing voxel values into binary bit-planes and reformulating reconstruction as per-bit binary classification.
summary: Lossless-INR is a volumetric neural representation framework that guarantees bit-exact reconstruction by decomposing data into binary bit-planes and optimizing them as classification tasks.
